# SmartDevBox

> SmartDevBox is a free, browser-based developer toolbox at https://smartdevbox.com.
> It auto-detects the format of any input and applies the correct tool instantly —
> no sign-up, no install, 100% client-side. All 91 built-in tools run in the browser;
> your data never leaves your machine.

## What SmartDevBox does

SmartDevBox solves a common developer problem: you have a blob of text — a Base64
string, a JWT, a minified JSON object, a Unix timestamp, a PEM certificate — and you
need to decode, format, or inspect it quickly. Instead of searching for the right
tool and navigating to it, you paste into SmartDevBox and it automatically detects
the format and applies the correct tool in under 600 milliseconds.

## Key facts

- 91 built-in tools across 6 categories
- Automatic format detection for 19+ formats including Base64, JSON, JWT, XML, SQL,
  URLs, Unix timestamps, X.509 certificates, cron expressions, hex strings, color
  codes, YAML, CSV/TSV, Markdown, UUIDs, ULIDs, Base32, Roman numerals, H:M:S
- Detection confidence scored 0–1; tools above 0.8 fire automatically, 0.3–0.8
  appear as suggestion chips
- 600 ms debounce so detection fires when you pause, not on every keystroke
- 100% client-side: no server, no account, no data upload
- Optional AI mode (OpenAI API key required) for ambiguous inputs only
- Plugin system: add custom tools, detectors, and transformers without forking
- Works offline after first load; can be self-hosted as a Next.js static export

## Tool categories

### Encoding & Decoding (18 tools)
Base64 Encode, Base64 Decode, Base32 Encode, Base32 Decode, URL Encode, URL Decode,
URL Parser, JWT Inspector, JWT Encoder, HTML Encode, HTML Decode, Hex to ASCII,
ASCII to Hex, Backslash Escape, Backslash Unescape, ROT13, ROT47, Base64 Image Decode

### Formatting (12 tools)
JSON Formatter, JSON Validate, XML Formatter, XML Minify, SQL Formatter,
CSS Beautifier, CSS Minify, HTML Beautifier, JS Beautifier, JS Minifier,
JS Validate, Markdown Preview

### Conversion (21 tools)
JSON to CSV, JSON to TSV, JSON to YAML, JSON to XML, YAML to JSON, CSV to JSON,
XML to JSON, Markdown to HTML, HTML to Text, HTML to JSX, JSON Escape, JSON Unescape,
Color Converter, Number Base Converter, Unix Timestamp, Date Formatter,
Seconds to H:M:S, H:M:S to Seconds, Decimal to Roman, Roman to Decimal, UUID ↔ Hex

### Generation (10 tools)
UUID v4 Generator, ULID Generator, Hash Generator (MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512),
Random String Generator, Random Password, Lorem Ipsum Generator, QR Code Generator,
Random Number, Random IP Generator, Random MAC Generator

### Inspection (6 tools)
Regex Tester, JSONPath Evaluator, String Inspector, Cron Job Parser,
Certificate Decoder (X.509), HTML Preview

### Text (17 tools)
Lowercase, Uppercase, Title Case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case,
CONSTANT_CASE, Invert Case, Line Sort, Line Dedupe, Line Reverse, Word Count,
Text Reverse, Text Trim, Remove Empty Lines, Number Lines, Prefix Lines, Suffix Lines,
Join Lines, Extract Emails, Extract URLs, Extract Numbers, Split & Diff

## Privacy model

All 91 tools execute in the browser using client-side JavaScript. No input text is
ever transmitted to a server. Specifically:
- JWT tokens decoded locally — no secret required, signature not verified server-side
- X.509 certificates parsed locally — infrastructure details stay private
- JSON, XML, SQL, code formatted locally — no telemetry on content
- Hash generation (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512) computed locally via Web Crypto API
- The only exception: AI mode (disabled by default) sends a short format-detection
  prompt to OpenAI. Tool execution still happens client-side.

## Plugin system

SmartDevBox has a plugin API. A plugin is a ToolDefinition object with: id, name,
category, description, detect() (returns confidence 0–1), transform() (produces
output). Plugins appear in the sidebar, participate in auto-detection, and are
searchable via the Command Palette (⌘K). The /api/plugins endpoint and Plugin Manager
UI allow loading plugins at runtime without a rebuild.

## Common use cases SmartDevBox handles

- Decode a Base64 string: paste → auto-detected → decoded instantly
- Decode a JWT without a secret: paste → JWT Inspector → header + payload as JSON
- Format minified JSON: paste → JSON Formatter → pretty-printed with error highlighting
- Convert a Unix timestamp: paste → Unix Timestamp → UTC + local time displayed
- Parse a cron expression: paste → Cron Job Parser → plain-English explanation + next runs
- Decode a PEM X.509 certificate: paste → Certificate Decoder → subject, issuer, validity, SANs
- Compute SHA-256 hash: use Hash Generator → MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512 computed simultaneously
- Convert JSON to CSV: paste JSON array → JSON to CSV → downloadable CSV with headers
- Compare two JSON blobs: paste into Split & Diff → line-level diff with intra-line highlights
- Extract all URLs from a log file: use Extract URLs text tool

## Frequently asked questions

**What is SmartDevBox?**
SmartDevBox is a free, browser-based developer toolbox with 91 built-in tools that
automatically detects the format of your input and applies the correct tool instantly.

**Is SmartDevBox free?**
Yes. SmartDevBox is completely free with no account, no sign-up, and no paid tier.

**Does SmartDevBox send my data to a server?**
No. All 91 tools run entirely in the browser. Your input never leaves your machine.
The only exception is the optional AI mode, which requires your own OpenAI API key.

**How does auto-detection work?**
Every tool registers a detector function that scores input 0–1. When you paste,
all detectors run in parallel. The highest-confidence tool above 0.8 fires
automatically; tools scoring 0.3–0.8 appear as clickable suggestion chips.

**Can I use SmartDevBox offline?**
Yes. After the first page load, all tools work without a network connection because
the application is a Next.js static export cached by the browser.

**Can I add my own tools?**
Yes. The plugin system lets you register custom ToolDefinition objects that appear
alongside built-in tools in the sidebar, Command Palette, and auto-detection engine.

**What formats does SmartDevBox auto-detect?**
Base64 (standard and URL-safe), JSON, JWT tokens, XML/HTML, SQL, URLs, Unix timestamps
(10- and 13-digit), X.509 PEM certificates, cron expressions (5- and 6-field), hex
strings, color codes (HEX/RGB/HSL/HSV), YAML, CSV/TSV, Markdown, UUIDs, ULIDs,
Base32, Roman numerals, H:M:S durations — 19 format families in total.
